terrain_ai.model: DINO self-supervised ViT-S/8 on Earth, Moon and Mars elevation patches, domain-adversarial (Kaggle K3, 2 × T4)

model: Positive-unlabelled ensemble: tuned XGBoost + tuned LightGBM + logistic regression (Kaggle K5)
notes: Percentages are 'top X% of all land': 1% means only 1 in 100 land areas scores higher.
Independent sites were never used to build or tune the model; the model is retrained without known sites within 300 km of each one.
Formula = the mission factors only; blend = what the site shows by default (40% factors, 60% learned model).
Rocks factor partly uses volcano and crater catalogues, so volcanic and impact sites get some help by design.
